upcoming.title: Ballake Sissoko and Piers Faccini
upcoming.body:
GET TICKETS

worldclassmusic.live proudly presents 

Ballake Sissoko and Piers Faccini

www.ballakesissoko.com

doors 6:30pm / showtime 7:30pm

The new album is available on CD and vinyl at ticket check-out!

'gentle, captivating work.... poetic songs soaked in nature imagery and beautifully married to Sissoko’s intricate, dazzling playing' - The Guardian

Two decades after their first ever collaboration, British-Italian folk songwriter, Piers Faccini, and Malian kora virtuoso, Ballaké Sissoko, return with a mesmerizing album. This new and captivating musical dialogue — between a prodigious instrumentalist at the height of his powers and a gifted songwriter and wordsmith — deftly bridges continents and traditions, inventing new song forms.

The seeds of Our Calling were first planted when Sissoko and Faccini met at Label Bleu in the early 2000s. Their friendship grew as they linked and explored uncharted paths between Manding traditions and folksong forms. With its ten finely crafted tracks, Our Calling is a sonic and narrative praise song for migration in all its manifestations: seeds borne by the winds; Nightingales flying between West Africa and Europe at the turn of the seasons; humans, across the centuries, and along trade routes, sharing musical practices and rhythms.

The album’s originality is that it feels deeply Malian at its core, while also being seamlessly infused with an essence of folk songwriting; the two elements blending without one ever overshadowing the other. The duo’s ambition when they began imagining the album was clear: the musical language begins and ends with Manding traditions and modes. The songs had that creative brief. Their melodies, although sung in English, are constructed and stepped along Manding lines.

The originality of Sissoko and Faccini’s dialogue is best exemplified with the song “If Nothing is Real” — a song that succeeds in finding a home away from home, both on the African and European continents. It is a testament to the Nightingale, or Sorofé Kono in Bambara, the songbird that first inspired these old friends to compose music of their own calling.

upcoming.title: 2026 NRS Artist Showcase
upcoming.body:
GET TICKETS


New Room Studios’ first Artist Showcase will be on Thursday, September 24, 6-9 PM at Alberta Abbey in Portland, OR. $15-30 suggested donation; no one turned away for lack of funds.

Join us for a variety-style night of live musical and cultural performances, literature, short films, theatre, a DJ performance, visual arts and learn more about the arts programs that are making our communities better.

Come celebrate the power of art to move your body and soul.

New Room Studios is an artist-run nonprofit that helps artists have the practices they want to have and change their communities for the better. Come see the amazing things our folks are up to!

This will be your chance to see the incredible work of the diverse artists from around the state who we work with, including:

Okaidja AFROSO & Janny FLOW, Crystal AKINS, Amber BALL, Gabriel BARRERA, Jeff BEERS, Caminos de CRECIMIENTO, Collar de LUNAS, Mic CRENSHAW, Given Q. DAVIS & Queer Poetry TAKEOVER, Alanna FAGAN, Michelle FUJII, Jason GRAHAM (MOsley WOtta), Joaquin LOPEZ, Lora LAFAYETTE, Talilo MARFIL, Fish MARTINEZ, Ben MOORAD, Emilly PRADO (DJ Mami Miami), Yanely RIVAS, Jonny “Cool” SANDERS, Joe WHITTLE

This Showcase is possible thanks to the generous support of the Echo Fund, the Oregon Community Foundation, the James F. and Marion L. Miller Foundation, the Multnomah County Cultural Coalition and the Oregon Cultural Trust.

upcoming.title: An Idiot's Guide to Wine
upcoming.body:
GET TICKETS

⭐ The smash-hit stand-up comedy show, An Idiot’s Guide to Wine, has now arrived in Portland, OR! Experience an evening that pairs hilarious stand-up comedy with a curated tasting of six different wines. It’s an extraordinary blend of two pleasures that rarely come together, offering a unique opportunity to explore diverse flavors while enjoying a night of laughter. Get your tickets today!

🚨 Tickets are selling fast. Grab yours while you can! 🚨

👉 Please note: the experience is held in English
Highlights
🍷 A hilarious comedy show paired with a curated tasting of six different wine varietals
🧑‍🎓 Written by Merrick Watts, the only comedian in the world to possess a WSET (Wine & Spirit Education Trust) level 3 qualification
🌍 Embark on a wine adventure with six unique wines, each offering its own distinct flavor
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 For couples, friends, or solo attendees, An Idiot’s Guide to Wine offers the perfect blend of laughter, learning, and liquid courage

General Info
📅 Dates and times: select your date & time directly in the ticket selector
📍 Location: Alberta Abbey, 126 NE Alberta St, Portland, OR 97211
🗣️ Language: the experience will be held in English
👤 Age requirement: 21+
❓ Please consult the FAQs of this experience here
🍾 Alcohol consumption is voluntary. Non-alcoholic drinks are available for an additional fee, not included in the ticket price
🚫 Guests are not allowed to record the experience. If this rule is not followed, or if any videos taken are not deleted when requested, guests may be asked to leave

Description
Great wines, great jokes, perfect pairing. The Australian sensation, An Idiot’s Guide to Wine, is making its way to Portland, OR to deliver an evening of comedy and wine tasting. Guests will have the opportunity to sample six different wine varietals from around the world while enjoying a hilarious stand-up show written by Merrick Watts. Whether you’re a wine connoisseur or a total beginner, you’ll giggle and gulp your way through a night where the hardest part will be not to spill your wine while laughing. Get your tickets for An Idiot’s Guide to Wine in Portland, OR!

upcoming.title: The Jury Experience – The Killer AI: Will Portland Deliver Justice?
upcoming.body:
GET TICKETS

Step into the heart of a high-stakes trial with The Jury Experience in Portland. In this live theatre show, you are the jury—the power to deliver justice is entirely in your hands. You’ll examine every piece of the puzzle, from witness testimonies to forensic data, and ultimately decide: guilty or innocent?

Highlights
🤩 Enjoy a live theatre courtroom drama where you decide the final verdict
🕵️‍♂️ Dissect witness testimonies, unpack evidence, and weigh every argument
⚖️ Face complex moral dilemmas that challenge your convictions
❓ The final decision is yours: will the accused be set free or found guilty?

General Info
📅 Dates and times: select your date & time directly in the ticket selector
📍 Location: Alberta Abbey
⏳ Duration: 60 minutes
👤 Age requirement: 12+. Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult
♿ Accessibility: the venue is ADA compliant
🗣️ Language: English
📱 Bring your phone to scan QR codes and participate in key moments of the show
❗ Each case is a standalone story and can be enjoyed separately
❓ Please consult the FAQs of this experience here

Description
You’ve been called for jury duty. Step into the heart of a high-stakes trial that will challenge your beliefs about guilt, innocence, and the true meaning of justice. The Jury Experience takes live theatre to the next level, as the audience becomes part of the show. As a member of the jury, you’ll analyse witness testimonies, cross-examinations, and forensic evidence in your search for the truth. Every word matters. Every detail counts. And at the end, you must cast the vote that will determine the fate of the accused. Will justice be served? Well, that’s up to you. Get your tickets now for The Jury Experience: An Immersive Courtroom Case in Portland!

upcoming.title: SAW The Musical: The Unauthorized Parody of SAW
upcoming.body:
GET TICKETS

⭐ SAW The Musical: The Unauthorized Parody of Saw is a brilliant combination of killer comedy and twisted romance, turning cinema's most iconic horror trap into a laugh-out-loud musical parody you'll never see coming.

Highlights
🎭 A bold parody blending Saw’s intense horror with raunchy comedy and an unexpected love story
🔪 Explicit sexual humor, simulated gore, and intense strobe effects — not for the faint-hearted
🎶 Like Little Shop of Horrors meets Avenue Q, pushing boundaries on sexuality and life
🩸 Fans of Saw will love the clever references and twisted love story
🏆 Praised as a “Gay Cult Classic” with hilarious absurdity and genuine affection for the original series

Description
One of the most thought-provoking horror films of all time is now a musical parody! SAW The Musical hilariously reenacts the original’s bathroom trap scene where Lawrence Gordon and Adam Stanheight meet for the first time. Will they follow the twisted rules and escape the deadly game? Filled with fluidity, laughs, and lots of fluids, this show is a boundary-pushing love story with sharp wit and nods to Saw fans. Expect a wild ride blending horror, humor, and heartfelt moments, perfect for fans who want to laugh their way through this classic’s legacy. Join the waitlist now and don’t miss the ticket release!

upcoming.title: The Jury Experience – The Killer AI: Will Portland Deliver Justice?
upcoming.body:
GET TICKETS

Step into the heart of a high-stakes trial with The Jury Experience in Portland. In this live theatre show, you are the jury—the power to deliver justice is entirely in your hands. You’ll examine every piece of the puzzle, from witness testimonies to forensic data, and ultimately decide: guilty or innocent?

Highlights
🤩 Enjoy a live theatre courtroom drama where you decide the final verdict
🕵️‍♂️ Dissect witness testimonies, unpack evidence, and weigh every argument
⚖️ Face complex moral dilemmas that challenge your convictions
❓ The final decision is yours: will the accused be set free or found guilty?

General Info
📅 Dates and times: select your date & time directly in the ticket selector
📍 Location: Alberta Abbey
⏳ Duration: 60 minutes
👤 Age requirement: 12+. Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult
♿ Accessibility: the venue is ADA compliant
🗣️ Language: English
📱 Bring your phone to scan QR codes and participate in key moments of the show
❗ Each case is a standalone story and can be enjoyed separately
❓ Please consult the FAQs of this experience here

Description
You’ve been called for jury duty. Step into the heart of a high-stakes trial that will challenge your beliefs about guilt, innocence, and the true meaning of justice. The Jury Experience takes live theatre to the next level, as the audience becomes part of the show. As a member of the jury, you’ll analyse witness testimonies, cross-examinations, and forensic evidence in your search for the truth. Every word matters. Every detail counts. And at the end, you must cast the vote that will determine the fate of the accused. Will justice be served? Well, that’s up to you. Get your tickets now for The Jury Experience: An Immersive Courtroom Case in Portland!

past.title: Make Waves presents Twisted Whistle: Bring it on Home A Reunion, a Concert
past.body:
ft. Portland’s Next Generation of Musicians

Twisted Whistle was formed in 2009, featuring the songwriting and powerful vocals of front person Kina Lyn Muir, and made complete by the very fine musicianship of Matt Franzen, Jeff Hays, and David Gerow. The band hit the ground running, boasting several years of many notable performances in the PNW and beyond. Described by Music Street Journal as a “blend of styles … bluegrass and country-tinged rock, with plenty of folk … “Psychobilly” really [doesn’t] begin to sum this band up, but they do have some of that attitude to go with it,” their debut album “Through the Mill” was named Best Americana Album of 2012 by Tupelo Honey KRVM. After a few more grand hurrahs, the band went their separate ways in late 2013, as Jeff and David each moved far, far away.

Kina Lyn and Matt continued to perform and record in many different capacities locally and all around, but also came into a new musical passion: Make Waves. Founded by Kina in 2020, Make Waves is a 501(c)3 which exists to support equity in music education for students and their teachers. What this support looks like is providing kids with instruments and connecting them to private music education, promoting and implementing diverse hiring practices, as well as creating paths to further accesibilty through music educator trainings.

Make Waves makes its home right here at The Alberta Abbey where Kina runs music educator trainings, as well as free music programming for local youth, and authors music education cirricula, and Matt fixes up donated instruments for local, young musicians in his workshop.

This exciting event will double as a fundraiser for Make Waves, opening with the support of several local, young musicians, and culminating with two sets of Twisted Whistle (trio), welcoming Jeff back home for a special reunion, and syrupy-sweet three-part harmonies.

Tickets are offered priced on a sliding scale, with the option to donate directly to Make Waves, as well.

past.body:

Alberta Abbey | Portland, Oregon

Kat Macmillan: 7:30-8:15 PM
Youssoupha Sidibe: 8:30-10:00 PM

Join us for a deeply moving evening of sacred music, prayer, and connection with Youssoupha Sidibe at Alberta Abbey in Northeast Portland. Rooted in the rich musical traditions of West Africa while infused with soulful melodies, meditative rhythms, and contemporary global influences, Youssoupha’s music invites audiences into a heart-centered experience of reverence, celebration, and collective presence.

The evening will begin with a devotional opening set by Portland vocalist and sound practitioner Kavita Kat Macmillan, whose work weaves together mantra, ritual, embodied voice, and deep listening. From there, Youssoupha Sidibe will guide the room through the transcendent sounds of the kora, expressive vocals, and immersive sonic landscapes, offering space to listen deeply, gather in community, and experience music as a bridge between cultures, histories, and spirit.


Youssoupha Sidibe

Youssoupha Sidibe is a Senegalese West African kora (African harp) player whose music transcends tradition while remaining deeply rooted in ancestral lineage. Throw out all your ideas of what a harpist is. Youssoupha breaks beyond traditional kora styles hundreds of years old to create a sound entirely his own, blending the ethereal beauty of the 21-string kora with soulful melodies and contemporary global influences.

Through decades of international touring, collaboration, and performance, Youssoupha has developed a devoted audience around the world. Grammy nominated for his collaboration with Matisyahu on “Youth,” he has recorded and performed with artists including Michael Franti, India.Arie, Bela Fleck and the Flecktones, Steve Kimock, Midnite, Michael Kang of String Cheese Incident, Chris Berry Trio, Shimshai, and many others.

A devoted practitioner of the Baye Fall Sufi tradition, Youssoupha’s music carries a deep sense of devotion, healing, and spiritual connection. His performances are more than concerts. They are immersive experiences of rhythm, prayer, joy, and remembrance.


Kavita Kat Macmillan

Kavita Kat Macmillan is an interdisciplinary vocalist, musician, and performer whose work bridges yoga, somatic practice, devotional singing, and creative awakening. Through mantra, ritual, sound yoga, and embodied movement, Kat creates immersive experiences that invite participants into deeper listening, authentic expression, and relationship with themselves, their ancestors, and the natural world. Her performances weave together voice, prayer, improvisation, and presence to create spaces of intimacy, reflection, and collective connection.

Chris Turner, Keys

A Portland native and Jefferson High alumnus, Chris has a rich background in R&B, Gospel, and Jazz-infused funk. In addition to serving as co-music director for BET’s Super Bowl Gospel celebration, he is a featured artist in Keyboard Magazine and has released his own project, “Love & Legacy.”

Eldon T Jones, Sax

A Lifetime Achievement Award recipient from the World Arts Foundation, Eldon is a pillar of the Portland jazz scene. He has performed at legendary venues such as Yoshi’s and Jazz Alley and has opened for Earth, Wind & Fire. His solo singles, including “T’s Jam,” have seen significant success on the Billboard and Smooth Jazz Network charts.He recently headlined a sold-out First Call Showcase at The Old Church for the Portland Jazz Festival.

Raised in the church, Nehemiah began headlining concerts and recording by his early teens. He gained national recognition as a member of the gospel group Soul, signed to a Universal subsidiary, where his work spent nine weeks on the Billboard gospel charts. He is known for his powerful vocal presence and deep roots in the Portland music community.

A 12-year recurring soloist for the Oregon Symphony’s “Gospel Christmas,” he has shared the stage with artists such as Josh Groban, India Arie, and Pink Martini. Anthony has also branched out to explore other facets of the music industry including producing, instructing, and product design & development. His diverse career has opened doors to work with some of the music industry’s top professionals.He joined Pink Martini in 2011 as a full-time member, and continues to record and tour nationally with the band.

Torry performs with undeniable musical inspirations such as Eldon T Jones and N'Touch, The LaRhonda Steele Band, Ronnie Wright, Chris Turner.

past.title: Clearing the Water: Defeating the Harmful Algae Bloom in Ross Island Lagoon
past.body:
MORE INFORMATION & RSVP

Recurring harmful algae blooms (cyanobacteria) in the Ross Island Lagoon have emerged as a recurring challenge for river users, public health officials, and environmental managers throughout the Lower Willamette River.

Join Dr. Desiree Tullos and the Oregon State University research team as they share the results of nearly a decade of research aimed at understanding the causes of these blooms and identifying science-based solutions to address them.

Dr. Tullos will present the project’s 30% engineering design, which evaluates options for restoring river circulation through the lagoon, including the creation of one or two new channels connecting the lagoon to the mainstem Willamette River. Modeling indicates that increased flow through the lagoon could substantially reduce water stagnation, improve water quality, decrease conditions that favor harmful algae blooms, and enhance ecological function throughout the system.

The 30% design represents the first stage of detailed engineering and provides a roadmap for evaluating feasibility, costs, permitting requirements, and expected outcomes. This work represents the first science-based restoration strategy developed specifically to address recurring harmful algae blooms in the Ross Island Lagoon and their impacts on the Lower Willamette River.

The convening will bring together community members, Tribal representatives, regulatory agencies, researchers, conservation organizations, and other stakeholders to review the findings, discuss public health and ecological implications, examine implementation opportunities and challenges, and explore pathways toward long-term restoration of this important urban waterway.

Together, we will discuss practical and equitable strategies to reduce harmful algae blooms, improve river health, protect public access and recreation, and advance a healthier, more resilient, and more swimmable Willamette River for future generations.

This event is free and open to the public. 

We anticipate strong community interest and expect the event to reach capacity, so we encourage attendees to reserve tickets early.

Thanks to our partners and sponsors - Mult Co, Oregon State University, Alberta Abbey, HAP, EMSWCD, Spirit Mt, Senator Merkley

This is a one-of-a-kind all-female showcase for our community!
Honoring the artists and the music of legendary and contemporary vocalists that define R&B and Soul.
From Chaka to Sade, Alicia Keys, Angie Stone, Ella Mai and more, we salute.
This night features the essence of female vocal creatives we all know & remember.
There is no better way to celebrate Black Music Month then by supporting Elevate Unity and Alberta Abbey nonprofits doing the work behind the scenes to build a safe space for all to share music, unite and heal our city and neighborhoods right now.

This all-female vocal lineup features the dynamic duo Brika De Tar and Claire Newrones of Onyx Soul, Madison Rose of the Sade tribute band Paradise, and Ruby Jones, soulful vocalist known for her work alongside jazz legend Eldon T. Jones, plus the iconic voice of power house singer Saeeda Wright.

Backed by The Free Tones Band, audiences can expect an evening of timeless songs, smooth harmonies, powerful performances, and music spanning the last five generations of Soul and R&B.

We're showcasing some of Portland's top song sirens on one stage for one epic night of music! It's a guarantee you will be moved by the passion and smooth subtle harmonies these talented ladies deliver.

Performing historic songs from over the last 5 generations this show highlights local talent you may not have heard of yet, but won't soon forget.


Unique and vocally diverse they easily cross multiple music styles seamlessly to deliver a one-of-a-kind inspiring musical experience.


Get you tickets early and join us for some great food, cocktails, music & community.

Brika De Tar

Singer/Songwriter

Brika began her singing career over 15 years ago, performing in various venues throughout the Nashville music scene as well as in Portland, OR, appearing at festivals and venues throughout both regions.

Brika’s vocal vibe is fashioned from the world of R&B, neo soul, jazz, and the genres we all love most. She has undeniable energy, with a sultry and transparent vocal vision on life and love that will take you on a much-needed musical journey.

She has dedicated herself to creating an atmosphere in which you can feel the vulnerability of her soul’s deep love for the art of music from the first to the last note she sings.

Claire Newrones

Lead Vocalist

Claire is new to the Portland music scene, but is no stranger to singing and performing.

She grew up singing at various competitions, county fairs, and as part of various performance and travel groups. Most recently, she spent two years in a college singing group that performed throughout Southern California and New York City.

Claire’s vocal style is inspired by the world of R&B, soul, and pop, and her love and passion for music and people is apparent every time she performs.

Madison Rose

Lead Vocalist

Known affectionately as Maddie, this breakout talent is a passionate Portland-born and based vocalist.

Madison is classically trained with jazz influences, and loves gospel and neo soul. Starting her career as a background vocalist, she has performed with several incredible choral groups and for events like the Nike Sneaker Ball.

Her new project and band, “Paradise,” is the hot new show-stopping Sade tribute unit. She's selling out shows, including the first two venues she's debuted at: Alberta Abbey and The 1905.

Her style is infectious, so keep your ears and eyes on this lady. Follow the journey, big things are coming.

Ruby Jones

Ruby Jones, known as Ruby Blue, is a Portland-based vocalist blending soul, jazz, gospel, and R&B. She began singing in church with her family and the Portland Metropolitan Youth Mass Choir, shaping her rich and expressive sound.

Now performing with the N Touch Band, Ruby has appeared across Portland and beyond, including the Cathedral Park Jazz Festival, Vanport Jazz Festival, and The Old Church Concert Hall. Her music reflects warmth, authenticity, and a deep connection to her roots.

Saeeda Wright

Saeeda Wright has been seen on stages backing Prince, as a member of his New Power Generation, the Pacific Northwest’s own Liv Warfield and is featured with the Tim Snider Trio.  She is very well known and respected for her work as a soloist with the Oregon Symphony, and has been a regular participant in Portland’s Annual Blues Festival. Currently Saeeda is a lead vocalist for the emerging band Mother’s Favorite Child and is working to complete her debut self-titled album. Besides the gifting and incredible work ethic put forth from this powerful woman, her dedication to her family, her faith, and giving back to her community remain her biggest priority.

The Free Tones

The Free Tones are a Portland-based band formed in early 2024 by drummer Justin Calhoun, who wanted to create a group focused on making music with friends on their own terms. Rooted in funk and soul, the band describes itself as a “good time” band, bringing energy and joy to every performance.

The lineup features vocalist Sharif Iman, bassist Russ Garlow, keyboardist Kenton Davey, guitarist Miguel Hernandez, saxophonist Ryan Visser, and drummer Justin Calhoun.

Healing to love is an immersive one woman theatrical experience that blend spoken word, storytelling music and spiritual reflection to explore the journey from emotional pain to self restoration and love rooted in the lived experience of a black woman. Through a powerful three act structure, the breaking the awakening and the rise audiences are invited into transformative experience of reflection, connection and renewal healing to love is not simply a performance. It is an experience that allows people to see themselves feel deeply and leave changed.

Crystal Marion, the author and director an actor of healing to love is a community, philanthropist, mother sister, daughter friend, and all around leader. As she uses her skills in the literary arts to touch the heart souls and minds of others, she herself has found a way towards healing, love and empathy. Crystal looks forward to sharing her story of growth and acceptance with the world to see.

past.title: Derek Gripper & Alam Khan - May 20 and 21, Live in Portland!!
past.body:
MORE INFORMATION & TICKETS

worldclassmusic.live presents

Gripper * Khan

Live at the Alberta Abbey, May 20 and May 21

doors 6:30pm / show 7:30pm

https://www.gripperkhan.com/

In a rare and remarkable collaboration, Alam Khan—son of the legendary Ali Akbar Khan—joins forces with one of South Africa’s most innovative guitarists, Derek Gripper. The two first met in 2025 over a cup of tea in Alam’s teaching room, a meeting that it led to a spontaneous trio recording with South African guitarist Guy Buttery. Alam went on to join Derek in concerts with his long-time collaborator, the great Malian kora virtuoso Ballaké Sissoko, and then in an intimate duo recording session in the hills of Berkeley.

Alam and Derek focus on their respective immersions in deep classical traditions: Alam Khan brings a long apprenticeship under his father, mastering the infinite art of raga improvisation within the Indian classical tradition. Derek Gripper, originally trained in European classical and early string music, has spent years translating the complex language of the West African kora to the guitar. Through this long study of the 21-string harp, he developed a unique language of cyclical improvisation, breaking out of the bounds of composed music and using the polyrhythmic possibilities of classical guitar technique to re-imagine the beginnings of sound in string music, from harps and bows of the African continent.

Together, Alam and Derek explore the heights of spontaneous creation, re-imagining great African songs and Indian melodies through the art of spontaneous improvisation.

www.derekgripper.com | www.alamkhan.com

past.body:

With an opening set by Tevis Hodge Jr and a puppet-making craft before the show!

Oregon Children's Theatre is proud to present a special family concert by Portland favorites Red Yarn & Friends! Tevis Hodge Jr will open the show with a short set of family-friendly blues music, followed by a set by the Red Yarn Band. Then, Red Yarn & friends - including Tevis on guitar & guest vocalists Alexis Walker & Brael Armstrong - will present several new songs from their upcoming family musical, "Saturday Night at the Briar Patch." Red Yarn(aka Andy Furgeson) is a Texas-born, Oregon-based family performer who weaves roots music and puppetry into high-energy shows for all ages. With his engaging performances, rowdy folk-rock recordings, and playful music videos, this red-bearded bard reinvigorates American roots music traditions for younger generations. The Red Yarn Band blends folk, rock’n’roll, country and blues into a raucous, inclusive celebration of the multicultural musical heritage of the USA.

Oregon Children’s Theatre(OCT) is a non-profit, professional Theatre for Young Audiences based in Portland, having served well over three million children, teachers, and families since its founding in 1988. Its mission is to create welcoming, imaginative spaces that inspire curiosity, resilience, and connection for all children across Oregon and SW Washington. OCT envisions a future in which every child has meaningful access to the arts, participates in shaping vibrant, thriving communities, and experiences true belonging.

past.title: Blonde Aid: Dance for Democracy
past.body:
Blonde Neon teams up with a stacked lineup for an all-out-80's benefit concert supporting the Portland Immigrant Rights Coalition.

You've seen the news. Watched the videos. Maybe witnessed in-person injustices targeting immigrant families in our own backyard. Blonde Neon asked "what can we do?" So we brought in our friends The Wanna Be-52’s, DEVOtees, and Decadent ‘80s to host a benefit concert that will donate 100% of proceeds to the Portland Immigrant Rights Coalition (PIRC). This grassroots Portland organization runs a 24/7 hotline, provides legal support, and mobilizes volunteers to defend immigrant families across Oregon.

Music brings us together, and so does showing up for our Portland community. We are proud to support the people who enrich our city every day. Come for the music, stay for the community — and know that every ticket makes a difference.

Blonde Neon

Step into the neon glow and let the synth waves wash over you. Blonde Neon brings the electric energy of '80s new wave and rock to life, celebrating the fierce female voices that defined a generation.

From Blondie's punk-pop perfection to Heart's arena rock anthems, from the Go-Go's infectious energy to Berlin's sultry new wave sophistication, Blonde Neon covers it all. Whether you're craving the driving beat of Pat Benatar, the quirky charm of Missing Persons, or the electronic pulse of Yaz, this band delivers with precision, passion, and just the right amount of '80s attitude.

More than just a cover band, Blonde Neon is a celebration—a chance to relive the music that soundtracked the most electric decade in rock history. Come for the nostalgia, stay for the party, and dance like it's 1985 all over again.

The Wanna Be-52’s

The Wanna Be-52’s is Portland, Oregon’s tribute to the original post-punk, new wave pioneers, often hailed as being The World’s Greatest Party Band! From “Rock Lobster” to “Love Shack” and everything in between, this band has been polishing their authentic sounding, stripped down tribute for more than 12 years! They focus on the first two legendary albums (the “Red” and “Yellow” albums) and include later dance floor favorites from the band’s top charting hits. Attend any of their super energetic performances, and it’ll be a party out of bounds on your cosmic trip to Planet Claire and beyond.

DEVOtees

Hailing from Portland, OR, DEVOtees is the premier tribute band dedicated to celebrating the pioneering new wave and synth-pop sound of DEVO. They bring the energy, quirkiness, and innovative spirit of DEVO to life.

Decadent ‘80s

Portland’s longest running 80s night. Often imitated but never duplicated, every week D80s has been here for the last 22 years. If you know and love '80s Alternative music then this is your night. DJ NoN has been a club DJ and promoter for 36 years, playing clubs and events around the U.S. as well as in Canada, Mexico, Europe and China.

Step into the heart of a high-stakes trial with The Jury Experience in Portland. In this live theatre show, you are the jury—the power to deliver justice is entirely in your hands. You’ll examine every piece of the puzzle, from witness testimonies to forensic data, and ultimately decide: guilty or innocent?

Highlights

🕵️‍♂️ Dissect witness testimonies, unpack evidence, and weigh every argument
⚖️ Face complex moral dilemmas that challenge your convictions

You’ve been called for jury duty. Step into the heart of a high-stakes trial that will challenge your beliefs about guilt, innocence, and the true meaning of justice. As a member of the jury, you’ll analyse witness testimonies, cross-examinations, and forensic evidence in your search for the truth. Every word matters. Every detail counts. And at the end, you must cast the vote that will determine the fate of the accused. Will justice be served? Well, that’s up to you. past.body:
MORE INFORMATION & TICKETS

Doors at 7:00 | Show at 8:00

All ages are welcome.

Free parking is available in the lot across the street until full.

The new project of the world-renowned Senegalese griot Ablaye Cissoko!
Two singular artists, a music to clear the mind and inspire the senses.

Ablaye Cissoko (kora, Senegal) and Cyrille Brotto (accordion, France) perform a gift of poetic imagination and musical intelligence, at times so harmonious that it seems as if touched by grace.

“A masterful collaboration of kora and accordion ... a gem from start to finish” - Songlines UK

After 14 albums, 20 years of touring, and numerous remarkable collaborations across different music genres, Ablaye Cissoko surprises us once again by pairing with French diatonic accordion player Cyrille Brotto. This collaboration feels like a waltz between two realms of expertise, a conversation between two masterful instruments.

The duo takes us on a spiritual and intimate journey, offering a warm and graceful music that clears the mind and inspires the senses ... 

But between Ablaye Cissoko, one of the world’s most renowned kora players, and Cyrille Brotto, a prominent figure on the French traditional and folk music scene, this is more than just music: it’s a story of friendship and profound mutual respect…
